title: Gwangju Nam-gu Campus Opening
excerpt: Our Honam-region hub, the Gwangju Nam-gu campus, opens.
body: Hanbit opens a new preschool & kindergarten campus in Nam-gu, Gwangju, bringing inquiry-led science early education to families in the Honam region.

title: 2027 Admissions Now Open
excerpt: Applications for the 2027 school year are open across all campuses.
body: We are accepting applications across our preschool and kindergarten programmes for 2027. Information session dates are on the Events page.

title: STEAM Fair 2026
excerpt: Children's science-play projects, all in one place.
body: Our annual STEAM Fair returns this year, with children exhibiting science-play projects they explored and built.

title: New Sensory Science-Play Program
excerpt: A new play-based way to learn science.
body: We have introduced a new sensory science-play programme for our preschool and kindergarten children.
